description: Each customer message named the intake mailbox of a real legal-expenses insurer as its recipient. In the files below that recipient string was replaced by a fictional one of the same UTF-8 byte length, both in the raw message file and in the base64 copy and sha256 field inside the claim JSON. original_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the replaced string in UTF-8. evaluated_sha256 is the hash recorded in benchmark/manifest.json before the evaluation. Run python3 verify.py --restore-recipient STRING to rebuild the evaluated bytes.
